question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

He __paused__ several times while delivering the speech.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e. **'Halted'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **'Paused' **in this context means to stop for a brief period of time.(रुकना).

 
 
• **Example: **She paused for a moment before she answered the question.
 
 
 
• The synonym** 'Halted' **signifies temporarily stopping progress or movement. (ठहराया).
 
 
• **Example: **The construction work was halted due to bad weather.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer** is** 'Halted'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **'Persisted'** as per Option 1 is a verb that means to continue in an opinion or course of action in spite of difficulty or opposition. (डटे रहना)
 
• **'Stammered'** as per Option 2 refers to speak with sudden involuntary pauses and a tendency to repeat the initial letters of words.(हकलाया)
 
• **'Left' **as per Option 3 has numerous meanings based on its context, like moving away from a place or person, or the opposite direction of right.(छोड़ दिया)
